description: 令和元年農作物災害種類別被害統計(被害応急調査結果) [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Data Catalog Site of the Japanese government (data.go.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農林水産省. 本調査は、毎年、耕地の状況、収穫量等を調査し、耕地面積、農作物の作付面積、収穫量、被害面積・被害量等を、全国、都道府県（主産県）別等に提供しています。. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 農林水産省. Its tags are 統計, 統計調査結果, 農業_林業. It offers 61 resource(s) in pdf, xls. The portal shows 2023-04-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-datago-portal.
